spans.s:
अभोक्तृ अ-भोक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, or अ-भोगिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, not enjoying, not using, abstemious.

अ-भोक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be enjoyed or
used.
अ-भोग, अस्, m. non-enjoyment, not making use of.

आभोग 1. आ-भोग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. भुज्,
to curve, bend, with prep. आ), winding, curving,
curve, crease; crumpling; circuit, circumference, en-
virons, extension, fulness, expanse; a serpent; the
expanded hood of the Cobra Capella (used by Varuṇa
as his umbrella); effort, pains.

आभोग 2. आ-भोग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. भुज्,
to eat, enjoy), enjoyment, satiety, fulness, comple-
tion.
अ-भोग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be enjoyed.

अ-भोज्, क्, m., Ved. not affording enjoyment (to
the gods, i. e. refusing to sacrifice).
—अभोग्-घन्,
आ, m., Ved. killing the stingy (who will not sacrifice).
अ-भोजन, अम्, n. not eating, fasting, abstinence.
अ-भोजित, अस्, आ, अम्, not fed, not feasted.
अ-भोजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, not eating, fasting.

अ-भोज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be eaten, prohibited
as food, impure.
—अ-भोज्यान्न (˚य-अन्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, one whose food is not allowed to be eaten.

आ-भोगय, अम्, n., Ved. means of supporting life,
livelihood; (Sāy.) to be enjoyed (as Soma juice).

आ-भोगि, इस्, f., Ved. living, supporting life; (Sāy.)
enjoyment.
